tools.name: psl_score_lookup
tools.description: Convert a PSL score (0–8 looksmaxxing face rating scale) into its tier name, approximate population percentile and casual 1–10 equivalent.

tools.name: classify_face_shape
tools.description: Classify a face into one of 7 shapes (oval, round, square, oblong, heart, diamond, triangle) from three measured outline ratios, with a match % for every shape.

tools.name: lookup_looksmaxxing_term
tools.description: Define a looksmaxxing / PSL term (e.g. LTN, HTN, Chadlite, canthal tilt, hunter eyes, mog) and link to its full explanation.

tools.name: get_face_measurement_tool
tools.description: Return the link to FaceRuler’s free on-device tool for measuring a real face from one photo (PSL score, face shape, canthal tilt or facial ratios). Use when the user wants their own face measured.
